Title: Public Preview: Azure Data Explorer bindings for Azure Functions

Body.Content:
We're excited to announce the public preview of Azure Data Explorer (Kusto) Bindings for Azure Functions!

It's now easier than ever to read and write data from and to Kusto clusters in your Azure Functions. This new capability enables you to easily integrate Kusto with other Azure services and build powerful data processing pipelines.

Learn more from our documentation or from our blog.

Try it out today and let us know what you think!
